UniswapV4PoolManager.note: Deployed and operated by Uniswap, not by this repo. Verified via docs.uniswap.org/contracts/v4/deployments.

_comment: Single source of truth for what's actually live on Arbitrum Sepolia. Values above verified directly on-chain (not copied from a deploy log) before this file was created. scripts/deploy.ts overwrites the IntentCommitReveal entry on every fresh deploy, and now REQUIRES AncillaTreasuryMultisig and AncillaGuardianMultisig to already exist in this file (throws instead of silently defaulting treasury/guardian back to a single EOA); scripts/deploy-swap.ts overwrites the TestTokenA/TestTokenB/AncillaSwapPool/SwapExecutor entries on every fresh deploy, without touching IntentCommitReveal; scripts/deploy-treasury.ts overwrites the AncillaTreasuryMultisig entry on every fresh deploy; scripts/deploy-guardian.ts overwrites the AncillaGuardianMultisig entry on every fresh deploy — note that deploying either multisig does NOT retroactively wire it into an already-deployed target's treasury/guardian, since both fields are immutable, only into the NEXT deploy.ts (or deploy-hook.ts) run; scripts/deploy-hook.ts overwrites the UniswapV4PoolManager/Create2Factory/AncillaSwapHook/AncillaHookRouter/AncillaLiquidityRouter/AncillaHookPool entries on every fresh deploy, reusing the existing TestTokenA/TestTokenB and wiring treasury straight to AncillaTreasuryMultisig — its guardian is still a single EOA as of this deployment, a known gap tracked in README's mainnet-readiness table, not yet redone because a hook redeploy also requires re-mining its CREATE2 address and re-initializing its pool/liquidity, a heavier operation deliberately not bundled into this pass; scripts/demo*.ts read from here instead of each hardcoding their own (previously inconsistent, some stale) copy of the address.
